title.text: Protecting a baby in the car

why_how.text: Keep this rule in mind: Before a baby is born the mother wears the lap and shoulder belt low and snug, and after birth the baby rides in a car safety seat, an infant seat or a convertible seat in the infant or toddler position, and is never carried in someone's arms.

Keep this rule in mind: A household carrier, travel bed or cloth carrier must not be used in place of a car safety seat, and clothing with legs lets the harness fit snugly while a papoose bunting or sack sleeper does not.
